summary: Retest of the iteration 5 fixes (viewport 390x844). Backend: 30/30 pytest passed (new test_partner_iter6_fixes.py plus the iter5 regression file). TTS now uses tts-1-hd with the coral voice. New uncached /tts and /tts-public calls returned audio/mpeg, and no new 'tts primary failed' lines were logged (count stayed at 7, all old 'instructions' errors). The /avatar guard rejects external, look-alike and /api/files URLs, and accepts an uploaded /api/public-files URL. /share/item returns 404 for paused, sold and removed items. /go/item returns 404 for removed items, shows Android and iPhone store buttons when store links are set, and does not count WhatsApp/ user agents in share_clicks (a normal browser adds 1). Frontend: Listen shows a spinner while the voice loads (checked with a 2.5s delayed response) and clears afterwards. 'Change your photo' is #111 with white text, and the sheet title matches. A web mic denial followed by Allow shows 'Microphone is blocked' with Open settings, with no loop. Regression: a chat voice note sends (voice 201, then message 200, bubble shown) and the item card WhatsApp button opens api.whatsapp.com/send. One HIGH issue: the tts-public per-IP limit keys on an ingress IP that every client shares.

critical.issue: The last X-Forwarded-For hop is NOT the client. It is the shared Google LB/ingress IP 34.149.9.106 for every request. Observed XFF: '<client>, 104.22.64.55 (Cloudflare), 34.149.9.106'. A forged header gives '9.9.9.9, <real client>, <cloudflare>, 34.149.9.106'. So the 40/hour 'per-IP' limit is really a 40/hour limit for everyone. After 40 public Listen taps in an hour, the login-screen voice stops working for all users, and the failure is silent because the client swallows the error.

minor.issue: No store links are configured by default (no social_publishing setting is stored), so the page shows only the amass:// button, which does nothing when the app is not installed. A web fallback, such as an AMASS web market URL, is still missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Open settings' on web throws 'TypeError: Linking.default.openSettings is not a function', and nothing happens. Reference: /app/frontend/src/chatVoice.tsx:147

action_items: HIGH: In partner_app.py tts_public, key the limiter on the real client IP: use the CF-Connecting-IP header, or xff[-3] (the hop Cloudflare appended, just before the Cloudflare and Google LB hops), falling back to the last hop. Production may add different hops, so check there. Keep the global 600/hour cap.

chatVoice.tsx:147: on Platform.OS==='web', do not call Linking.openSettings. Show a hint such as 'Allow the microphone from the lock icon in your browser address bar', or hide the button, or wrap the call in try/catch.
go/item: when no store links are set, add a web fallback link (AMASS web market / item URL) next to 'Open in AMASS'.

Optional: stopAudio() does not invalidate a pending say() (sayId). If you leave a screen while TTS is still loading and auto-read is off, the old phrase plays on the next screen. Bump sayId in a stop helper called from the ScreenHeader focus cleanup.
Optional, out of scope: the seller home 'New offers' count uses status 'sent' only (shows 0), while the item cards show a 'New offer' pill for countered offers. Align the two.
critical_code_review_comments: SpeakButton (ui.tsx:47-52) has no try/finally around await speak(). It is safe today only because say() swallows all errors.

On web, expo-audio getRecordingPermissionsAsync() calls requestRecordingPermissionsAsync() when the permission state is 'prompt', so the browser prompt appears on the first mic tap, before the app's explanation sheet.
